_about: Homepage Editor's Picks (2026-10-27). Chosen by Okanagan Roam, never paid: a paid spot would be a separate row labelled Sponsored. The first 4 usable picks show (four a week since 2026-11-09); the rest are backups that step in, in order, when a pick is skipped (closed for the season or by a dated closure, not operating, or without its own photo). The row always shows 4 cards and hides with fewer than 4. 'why' is one short line (EN + FR). A pick can set 'photo' to another of the place's own photos (one that suits the season); it must be a wide (landscape) photo with the subject in the middle, since the card shows a wide strip.
